name: shimmer
title: Shimmer
description: Words that say work is under way, with light passing over them.
use: A status that can be said in words while the work runs: "Thinking", "Searching 14 files", "Deploying". Replace the line with its result when the work is done.

instead.when: The shape of the coming content is known and its words are not
There is nothing to say except that something is happening
The amount of work done is known
Words are already being written and more are coming

classes.name: shimmer
classes.description: Words in a quieter ink with a band of light passing over them; goes on the element that holds the words

properties.name: --shimmer-color
properties.description: Ink of the words at rest
